item.title: IT: WELCOME TO DERRY Spoilers: Episode 5 Finally Unleashes Pennywise The Clown After Show's Biggest Twist Yet
item.description: The fifth episode of It: Welcome to Derry, titled "29 Neibolt Street," finally unleashes Pennywise the Clown for a confrontation that turns the show on its head...and that's after a jaw-dropping return!

item.title: BLACK WIDOW Had A Huge Continuity Mistake, And I Can’t Get It Out Of My Head
item.description: Black Widow’s standalone film featured a pretty big time-period inconsistency. If you catch it, it’s tough to stop thinking about it.

item.title: The Rock And Emily Blunt's JUNGLE CRUISE Sequel Has Been Docked By Disney
item.description: Dwayne Johnson and Emily Blunt have confirmed that a Jungle Cruise sequel is no longer happening, citing a change in Disney leadership as the primary reason.

item.title: PREDATOR: BADLANDS Director Is Confident That A New ALIEN VS. PREDATOR Movie Will Happen... At Some Point
item.description: Though it sounds like we might be waiting a while, Predator: Badlands director Dan Trachtenberg seems fairly certain that a new Alien/Predator crossover will happen...

item.title: THE FLASH: Hot Toys' New Blue & Grey Suit BATMAN Figure Needs To Be Seen To Be Believed
item.description: Hot Toys has revealed a new 1/6th figure based on The Flash, and it features Michael Keaton's Bruce Wayne in the classic grey and blue suit, complete with the yellow logo. You can take a closer look here!

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Fan-Art Potentially Reveals Pedro Pascal's New Look As MCU's Mister Fantastic
item.description: A piece of fan art based on recent Avengers: Doomsday leaked costume photos reveals what Pedro Pascal's Reed Richards/Mister Fantastic will look like in the movie, but the changes are mostly minor...

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumors May Confirm Sadie Sink's Character's Identity And [SPOILER] Status
item.description: We have some new rumors relating to Sadie Sink's mysterious character in Spider-Man: Brand New Day here, and it sounds like this is indeed someone Peter Parker needs to be very careful of...

item.title: NEW MUTANTS Fan Favorite MOONSTAR Sets Out To Protect The Marvel Universe's Souls In First-Ever Comic Series
item.description: Next March, an iconic X-Man finally strikes out on her own in Moonster by Ashley Allen and Edoardo Audino, the first time the New Mutants fan favourite has led her own comic book series. Check it out!

item.title: DOCTOR STRANGE Star Benedict Cumberbatch May Have Just Confirmed His Next MCU Appearance - Possible SPOILERS
item.description: Doctor Strange star Benedict Cumberbatch has teased his MCU future as the former Sorcerer Supreme, and seemingly confirms when he'll return as Stephen Strange. You can hear more from the actor here...
